newsitem.title: USA: Ikon financing unit files $2 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Ikon financing unit files $2 bln shelf.

text.p: Ikon Capital Inc, a financing unit of Ikon Office Solutions Inc, filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $2 billion in debt securities.
Together with previously registered debt, the shelf offering totals $2,073,250,000.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to finance future sales and leasing transactions, according to the filing.
Underwriters may include Lehman Brothers, Chase Securities Inc, Goldman Sachs & Co and Merrill Lynch & Co, the company said in the shelf offering.
